6628.title: Draft submission ownership outlives a composer
6628.rootCauseOneLine: Shared drafts outlive view-local pending state, so overlapping callbacks clear newer input before an older failed send restores its snapshot.
6628.proposedFix: Serialize native draft-consuming callbacks by normalized storage key, publish shared pending state and release ownership in finally; preserve the empty-input queued shortcut and distinct-scope independence.
6628.caveats: Deterministic component lifecycle reproduction, not a fresh browser breakpoint or released macOS archive test; transport mutation is held/rejected rather than sent to a real provider.
